name: Current Capability Registry
purpose: Define the SLS capabilities that OSF-EC-001 is permitted to use when determining Problem Alignment and Capability Alignment.
admissibility_rule: A capability is ADMISSIBLE only when SLS can demonstrate it today through executable software, a validated framework, a proven workflow, or a bounded operational implementation.
governing_rule: Potential capability is not current capability.
platform_rule: AnchorOS is an enabling platform and SHALL NOT be treated as a generic customer-problem match.
inadmissible_categories: Apify platform capabilities not implemented by SLS

capabilities.name: Governed Commercial Intelligence
capabilities.claim: Convert external commercial information into governed, traceable evidence rather than treating raw information as authoritative intelligence.

capabilities.name: Live Public-Source Acquisition
capabilities.claim: Acquire bounded information from identified public sources while preserving source identity, acquisition receipt, and integrity information.

capabilities.name: Evidence Admission & Human Governance
capabilities.claim: Route acquired information through findings, authorized human review, and controlled evidence admission before authoritative commitment.

capabilities.name: Commercial Intelligence Registry
capabilities.claim: Maintain organizations, sources, evidence, relationships, markets, scorecards, and associated provenance in a structured commercial intelligence registry.

capabilities.name: Evidence-Bounded Organization Intelligence
capabilities.claim: Construct an organizational intelligence state from governed evidence while exposing missing information and withholding unsupported conclusions.

capabilities.name: Executive Intelligence Reporting
capabilities.claim: Transform governed commercial intelligence into executive-facing briefs with evidence basis, decision state, readiness, next justified action, and report integrity.

capabilities.name: Intelligence Gap Resolution
capabilities.claim: Detect deficiencies in an organization's intelligence state and deterministically generate prioritized, bounded collection requirements.

capabilities.name: Evidence-Contract-Driven Research Planning
capabilities.claim: Translate formal assessment obligations into specific evidence requirements rather than conducting open-ended AI research.

capabilities.name: Continuation-Validity Governance
capabilities.claim: Determine whether execution remains justified under current conditions and constrain or refuse continuation when validity no longer holds.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Verification, Evidence & Replay
capabilities.claim: Produce evidence, receipts, replay, and verification artifacts supporting review of governed execution and continuation decisions.
